text: The Patriots dominated the Steelers 20-3 in their Week 2 home opener at Gillette Stadium, with TreVeyon Henderson scoring a touchdown as the defense carried a team that hasn't yet fully recaptured the offensive momentum from their Super Bowl run last season—a victory that made New England the first of the original AFL teams to reach 600 wins. The win came with a significant cost, however, as starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle with initial X-rays confirming the injury, a blow to the offensive line that could loom large in upcoming weeks. Off the field, Stephon Gilmore, the 2019 NFL Defensive Player of the Year and two-time All-Pro cornerback, signed a one-day contract on Friday to retire as a member of the Patriots, bringing a fitting bookend to his legendary tenure in New England.
